topic: The asteroid that ended the dinosaurs
script: About 66 million years ago, an asteroid wiped out most of the dinosaurs. It was roughly 10 kilometers wide. It slammed into what is now Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula. The crater it left, called Chicxulub, is about 180 kilometers across. Birds survived, and they are living dinosaurs today. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
